tagline: Self-hosted social media scheduler built on Laravel, with a free Lite edition and a paid Pro edition.
description: Mixpost is a social media scheduling tool written in PHP on the Laravel framework. The free Lite edition in this repository gives you a calendar, a media library, post versions and labels, and basic analytics. You install it yourself, with Docker, a manual PHP setup, or inside an existing Laravel app. The docs advise running it on a public domain or subdomain, because the app has to talk to the social networks' servers. Lite requires PHP 8.2 or newer. The project also sells Mixpost Pro as a one-time purchase and runs a hosted Cloud service. Pro adds the features a team usually needs, such as an approval flow, an API and publishing to every supported network. As a replacement for Hootsuite or Loomly, Lite covers solo scheduling on three networks. Teams that need approvals, wider network coverage or an inbox have to buy Pro, which is a commercial product with its own licence. The code in this repository is MIT licensed.
strengths: Runs in Docker, as a manual PHP install, or inside an existing Laravel application
Lite includes a calendar, a media library, post versions and post labels at no cost
Pro is a one-time $299 payment for one domain, with no per-seat monthly fee
Documented MCP server and API on the Pro edition for automation
limits: Lite publishes only to Facebook Pages, Mastodon profiles and X profiles; all other networks need Pro
Approval flow, first comment, hashtag manager, post templates and the API are listed under Pro, not Lite
The maintainers ask that Lite contributions stay distinct from Pro features, so Pro-only features will not land in Lite
Needs a public domain or subdomain, so a purely local install is not practical
bestFor: A solo creator or small brand with a VPS that schedules posts to Facebook Pages, Mastodon and X and does not need approvals.
